meetings.summary: The committee reviewed South Maui Community Plan map changes, voted 7–0 on four amendments, and deferred the bill to the next meeting.

meetings.summary: The Council held a special meeting welcoming Fukuyama City Assembly members, a sister city since 2008. Council members answered questions on water delivery, federal rebuilding aid and the County's insurance gap program, and the delegation gave a denim tablecloth.

meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission Interviews 3 DPS Director Candidates
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission interviewed candidates for DPS director and plans to meet October 7 to review them and hopefully decide.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Special Meeting

meetings.summary: Council members discussed West Maui water, where the county controls delivery of 23 percent, and a county insurance gap program for homeowners rebuilding. The delegation was set to give an evening presentation at UH Maui College.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.summary: The Council advanced water wells for Hawaiian Homelands, sent a Seabury Hall request to the Planning Commission, and backed Kauaʻi hurricane aid.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting - (recessed from 9/25/26 mtg)
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Meeting - (recessed from 9/25/26 mtg)
meetings.summary: The Council voted 5–4 to adopt a committee report backing a resolution asking the Maui Planning Commission to consider hotel zoning for coastal apartment properties.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting

meetings.summary: The council advanced a Hawaiian Homelands wells plan nine to zero and sent a coastal hotel-rezoning resolution to planners, five to four.

meetings.summary: Testifiers addressed Resolution 26-129, on possible hotel zoning for some apartment-zoned coastal properties, and Lahaina town rebuilding. Bill 85 would allow Planning Commission hearing notices in any countywide publication. The Council recessed with no objections.

meetings.body: Civil Service Commission

meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission set interviews for the 30th and voted to invite DPS employees to take part in the selection process.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee amends South Maui Community Plan actions and defers the item
meetings.summary: The committee voted 8–0 to support a Ridge to Reef group and 7–0 for a tourism impacts plan, then deferred the item. It plans to meet Wednesday morning for more public testimony, starting with Planning Department presentations.

meetings.summary: The chair paused the session after the clerk took roll and said it will reconvene at 9 a.m. on the same Teams link. The chair also announced a meet and greet with a Fukuyama City Council delegation at the council chamber.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council recesses meeting because of severe weather, to reconvene at 9 a.m.
meetings.summary: The chair recessed the meeting after roll call, with a quorum confirmed and no vote taken. It reconvenes at 9 a.m. on the same Teams link. A meet-and-greet with a visiting council delegation is set for 4 to 5 p.m.

meetings.summary: The committee continued South Maui Community Plan changes, approving watershed and recycled water actions and a desalination study by six ayes, three noes.

meetings.headline: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.summary: The committee deleted two action items and amended others on cesspools, shoreline access and wildfire.

meetings.summary: The Independent Nomination Board interviewed applicants in a closed session and set November 11th as the application deadline for 2027 mass nominations.

meetings.summary: The committee continued reviewing Bill 108, approving tree-care training workshops and a park study, and deleting action 2.32 as similar to action 2.24. The chair said the goal is to get as far as possible by October 8.

meetings.summary: The committee took up Bill 108, the 2026 South Maui Community Plan update, and voted on amendments to actions 1.09, 1.24, 2.02 and 2.10. The chair said the posted Wednesday meeting would be canceled.

meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Commission voted to use an open application process and create a small group to hire a search firm for a new director.

meetings.summary: The commission approved its minutes and voted to request a list of county-funded youth programs, aiming to build awareness of available resources.

meetings.headline: Committee works on South Maui Community Plan, Bill 108, and votes on flood and housing policies
meetings.summary: The committee took up Bill 108 and voted on policies on flooding, housing outside special flood hazard areas, and government trails. It plans to hear public testimony on Monday, and the chair will work on Policy 2.3.6.

meetings.summary: The Fire and Public Safety Commission approved its fiscal year 2026 annual report and heard emergency management, fire department and fire shop updates.

meetings.headline: Board of Water Supply Rejects Bill 1 CD1, Reviews West Maui Wells
meetings.summary: The Board of Water Supply voted not to support Bill 1 and heard a timeline for new West Maui wells.

meetings.summary: The county plans to keep Lānaʻi ferry service and expand to Molokaʻi, hoped for by early 2029, with a private company running it.

meetings.summary: The commission approved a farm subdivision notice bill on a second vote and reviewed a permit for a private Four Seasons event.

meetings.headline: Committee defers Bill 108 after hearing public testimony
meetings.summary: The chair deferred Bill 108 with no objections after closing oral public testimony, keeping it for later meetings. Written testimony stays open, and the chair said the committee has through October 8 for its review.

meetings.headline: Residents testify on updated South Maui Community Plan
meetings.summary: In South Maui, the committee heard public testimony on Bill 108, the updated South Maui Community Plan, and deferred the item.

meetings.summary: Committee members proposed new criteria and shoreline conditions for two resolutions and planned a recess to research before voting.

meetings.summary: Liquor commissioners accepted a brewery's application despite zoning questions, renewed a wildfire emergency rule, and heard the director will retire December 31.

meetings.summary: Members took up a limit on rezoning based on 2008 resident use; a version not applying to flood hazard areas passed. The chair said conditions will be set after Maui Planning Commission review. A motion to adopt a resolution was pending when the recording ended.

meetings.headline: Banyan supports added; Kula burn scar fencing and replanting update
meetings.summary: The Arborist Committee heard a banyan tree update, planned exceptional tree measurements, and heard about fencing and replanting in the Kula burn scar.

meetings.body: Maui Liquor Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Liquor Commission
meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Commission accepted a brewery's application pending zoning, and the department director announced his December 31 retirement.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Housing and Land Use Committee members ask to defer property tax item
meetings.summary: Members asked to defer an item after staff who could answer questions were not present. Earlier discussion included the Finance Department's description of a tax correction as a department error.

meetings.body: Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The board formed one TIG to interview applicants and, after closed-door interviews, voted to send names to several boards.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee's motion to file resolution fails 4-5; recording ends before adoption vote

meetings.body: Council on Aging
meetings.headline: Council on Aging
meetings.summary: The Council on Aging had ethics training and heard the office won $390,000 for a program helping older adults leaving the hospital.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.summary: Maui Planning Commission recommended a Pāʻia community plan change unanimously and a zoning change for about 170 homes, 5 to 3.

meetings.summary: The Council heard testimony on Bills 163 CD1 and 164 CD1, including concerns about water and an unfinished environmental impact statement.

meetings.summary: Commissioners sent ferry recommendations, approved a plan for seven Lahaina homes with an archaeological monitor, and approved a letter on Section 106 changes.

meetings.summary: The committee heard police, prosecutors and the public on Bills 112 and 113 on facial recognition and license plate readers, then recessed until tomorrow.

meetings.summary: Committee backs resolution to settle federal retirement pay lawsuit.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.summary: The project includes three wells, a storage tank, and a pipeline to the county water system.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.summary: A wildfire health study reported fewer people in temporary housing but 23% still severely food insecure; the committee deferred the item.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee questions health study team, hears update on Kīlohana housing units
meetings.summary: The committee asked a health study team about park access, insurance enrollment and outreach, and heard Kīlohana units and land are moving to county control. Council members are to email the team to schedule follow-up meetings.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses DHHL well agreement, defers road herbicide waiver
meetings.summary: Under the draft agreement, DHHL would receive all of the wells' estimated 1.728 million gallons per day, and an amendment passed seven to zero. Public Works' waiver request was deferred; a member wants specific areas and a shorter time period when it returns.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee closes oral testimony, takes lunch recess before criteria discussion
meetings.summary: A testifier who bought a unit at Kīhei Gardens Estate in 2024 said she supports the resolutions but wishes her unit were included. Written testimony will still be accepted, and members plan to discuss criteria when they return at 2.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee approves amendment on property criteria, 5–4
meetings.summary: Members voted 5–4 to approve an amendment on sea-level rise and housing criteria and will reconvene September 9 at 10 a.m.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Residents testify on hotel zoning proposals for apartment units
meetings.summary: Residents testified on proposals to move apartment units into H3 and H4 hotel zoning; many said the proposals undermine Bill 9.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee debates shoreline and flood criteria for structures
meetings.summary: The committee discussed amending criteria for structures affected by shoreline and flood hazards, then took a five-minute recess without a vote.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee weighs flood and sea level criteria for zoning changes
meetings.summary: Committee weighs flood and sea level criteria for zoning changes.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Testimony continues on Kīhei and West Maui plan changes
meetings.summary: The committee heard public testimony on two resolutions to amend the Kīhei-Mākena and West Maui Community Plans, then took a break.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee closes testimony and passes criteria amendment on a five-to-four vote
meetings.summary: After the chair closed oral testimony, the committee passed an amendment to the property criteria with five ayes and four noes. Another member proposed a criterion on 2008 unit occupancy, and staff will double-check which properties meet the criteria.

meetings.body: Maui Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Civil Service Commission
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission approved a reference questionnaire and candidate letter topics and set September 30 interviews for a new personnel director.

meetings.body: Public Works Commission Recommends Denial of Kula Park Renaming
meetings.headline: Public Works Commission Recommends Denial of Kula Park Renaming
meetings.summary: The Public Works Commission voted to recommend against renaming Kula Park and got training on open meeting and ethics rules.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission approved five homes in Lāhainā and Outrigger resort upgrades with added beach parking and shoreline conditions.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council passes purchase of private water system assets for up to $6 million, 8–1
meetings.summary: The deputy water director said the assets include wells, transmission lines and storage tanks, and that funding is already in the account. The department said a six-month due diligence period will show the County's total administrative costs.

meetings.body: Commission on Children & Youth
meetings.headline: Commission on Children & Youth
meetings.summary: The Commission on Children and Youth approved a 2028 budget request, a brochure and website updates, and reviewed family survey results.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends Bill 90 on first reading for Haʻikū Fire Station
meetings.summary: The committee took up Bills 89, 90 and 91 for a proposed Haʻikū Fire Station and met in executive session. It required the parcel's remaining farm land to be used for subsistence agriculture, and staff will work with attorneys on the wording.

meetings.body: BLNR Rejects Mahi Pono Long-Term Water License
meetings.headline: BLNR Rejects Mahi Pono Long-Term Water License
meetings.summary: The state land board rejected a staff recommendation to start a long-term water license for Mahi Pono, a vice chair reported.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Kōmike Aloha ʻĀina
meetings.headline: Committee discusses Act 171 transition to Maui County, defers the item
meetings.summary: The chair said Senate Bill 1432 became Act 171 on June 26, 2026, and Maui County takes over the area one year after the last patient leaves. Oral public testimony was closed and the item was deferred.

meetings.body: Board of Water Supply
meetings.headline: Board of Water Supply
meetings.summary: The board heard that BLNR denied a long-term Mahi Pono water license proposal, and it approved a planning letter and a TIG report.

meetings.body: Water Commission Approves TIG Report on Lahainā Water Permits
meetings.headline: Water Commission Approves TIG Report on Lahainā Water Permits
meetings.summary: The board unanimously approved a TIG report on water use permit applications in the Lahaina surface and groundwater management area.

meetings.body: Who Really Owns East Maui's Water System?
meetings.headline: Who Really Owns East Maui's Water System?
meetings.summary: A presenter questioned whether a private company truly owns the East Maui ditch system, citing old licenses and state land.

meetings.body: Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.headline: Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.summary: The commission adopted the fire chief's 2026 evaluation and heard that Maui has had 14 drownings this year, all at unguarded beaches.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.summary: The committee heard plans to move disaster survivors' interim housing to county programs and voted 7–0 to meet privately on water assets.

meetings.body: Maui Police Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Police Commission
meetings.summary: In closed session, the Maui Police Commission voted to suggest unpaid leave for a lieutenant and approved hiring an investigator.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Housing committee hears more testimony on condo rezoning lists
meetings.summary: The Housing and Land Use Committee heard more testimony on Resolutions 26-129 and 26-130 and plans to reconvene Thursday.

meetings.body: Lānaʻi Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Lānaʻi commission hears update on inter-island internet cable
meetings.summary: The commission heard a presentation on a proposed undersea internet cable; no action was taken, and the next meeting is September 16.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends Resolution 26-132, discusses special counsel spending limit
meetings.summary: The committee voted 7 to 0 to recommend adopting Resolution 26-132. Members also took up Resolution 26-131, which would raise the limit for special counsel by $250,000, to $450,000 total.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee reviews disaster recovery funds and proposed grant rules
meetings.summary: The committee heard a $1.6 billion disaster recovery funding update and a first look at proposed county grant rules, deferring both items.

meetings.body: Cost of Government Commission
meetings.headline: Cost of Government Commission
meetings.summary: The Cost of Government Commission voted to create a housing approvals study group and plans to invite County IT staff about cyber security.

meetings.body: Commission on Persons with Disabilities
meetings.headline: Commission on Persons with Disabilities
meetings.summary: Six commissioners were present, enough to hold the meeting.

meetings.body: Maui Civil Service Commission Advances DPS Director Search
meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission picks top four for public director interviews
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission voted to interview its top four director candidates in public, with interviews expected to start the week of September 28.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council authorizes lawsuit settlement, approves Aloha Classic permit, refers rezoning to committee
meetings.summary: The council voted to authorize settling a suit by the Conservation Council of Hawaiʻi and American Bird Conservancy and approved a Hoʻokipa permit for the 2026 Aloha Classic. Six-parcel rezoning and Bill 102 on parking went to the Water and Infrastructure Committee.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission Approves Lahaina Rebuild, Accepts Mākena EIS
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission Approves Lahaina Rebuild, Accepts Mākena EIS
meetings.summary: The commission approved a Lahaina fire rebuild with a 10-year shoreline survey rule and accepted the Mākena project's final environmental study.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.summary: Committee heard archaeology, water and land title questions on the Haʻikū fire station rezoning, met behind closed doors, and recessed to August 24.

meetings.body: Kīhei Desalination Study
meetings.headline: Water department shares Kīhei desalination study, hears resident concerns
meetings.summary: The water department shared desalination study options costing $119 million to $328 million, with construction 10 years or more away.

meetings.body: Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.headline: Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.summary: The commission heard Lahaina Royal Complex and Pāʻia project presentations and voted to answer a Cost of Government Commission report.

meetings.body: Maui Liquor Control Board
meetings.headline: Maui Liquor Control Board
meetings.summary: The chair paused that case so the business could seek a waiver of the conflict.

meetings.body: Cultural Commission Reviews Pāʻia Town Mixed-Use Development Project
meetings.headline: Cultural Commission Reviews Pāʻia Town Mixed-Use Development Project
meetings.summary: The Cultural Resources Commission heard a consultation request for a Pāʻia mixed-use project with housing and parking; no one testified.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meetings.summary: The committee recommended passing Bill 98, which would establish a Food and Nutrition Security Plan, with six ayes and one member excused.

meetings.body: Liquor Board Fines Haʻikū Market $2,000 for Minor Decoy Sale
meetings.headline: Liquor Board Fines Haʻikū Market $2,000 for Minor Decoy Sale
meetings.summary: The board fined the owner of Haʻikū Market $1,000 on each of two counts after a cashier sold alcohol to an 18-year-old decoy.

meetings.body: Cultural Resource Commission Reviews Mokuʻula Restoration Plan
meetings.headline: Cultural Resource Commission Reviews Mokuʻula Restoration Plan
meetings.summary: Commissioners heard an informational presentation on removing tennis courts, a basketball court and a parking lot to prepare the royal complex for restoration.

meetings.body: Board of Water Supply
meetings.headline: Board of Water Supply
meetings.summary: A board working group reported that Lahaina-area surface water permit requests total almost 9 million gallons a day, 213% of reported existing use.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.summary: The committee heard testimony on two resolutions to rezone some apartment properties as hotel districts for vacation rentals, then recessed to August 19, 2026.

meetings.body: Maui Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Commission weighs director candidates, asks DPS about fraud screening
meetings.summary: The commission heard a recommendation to interview six candidates for personnel director and voted to ask DPS for input on fraud screening.

meetings.body: Housing & Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Housing & Land Use Committee
meetings.summary: The committee heard testimony on two resolutions to rezone some apartment properties to hotel zoning and recessed to August 19, 2026.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Recovery update covers housing gap and water system purchase
meetings.summary: The committee heard updates on Maui's long-term recovery, housing, and a proposed water system purchase, and met in closed session.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends adopting water system purchase resolution on 7-1 vote
meetings.summary: The vote was seven to one with one member excused. The council chair had wanted to hear from the Board of Water Supply first. The resolution goes to the full council; the PUC must approve the sale, and closing is projected by April next year.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee takes up seabird streetlight settlement and enters executive session
meetings.summary: The committee took up Resolution 26-128, a proposed settlement of a claim that streetlights threaten three protected seabirds, and voted to go into executive session. A county attorney said trial is likely in February, March or as late as April next year.

meetings.body: Urban Design Review Board
meetings.headline: Urban Design Review Board
meetings.summary: The board approved a Lahaina fire rebuild design and passed two recommendations on a South Maui apartment project.

meetings.body: Lahaina Rebuild
meetings.headline: Lahaina Rebuild
meetings.summary: The board unanimously approved plans to rebuild a home and ohana destroyed in the August 8, 2023 Lahaina wildfire.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses taxicab baggage charges in Bill 101 (2026)
meetings.summary: Bill 101 would raise the general baggage charge from 50 cents to $1 per piece per trip and allow a $10 charge for certain oversized or heavy items. Members proposed amendments, and the chair said the bill will move on for first reading.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee passes water motion 7 to 1, discusses baggage charge proposals
meetings.summary: One member was excused for the water vote, which followed discussion of a purchase priced at up to $6 million, not counting closing costs. A member proposed $1 per bag and $10 for large items, and another moved to count bags of 50 pounds or more as oversized.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers subdivision water review bill for board input
meetings.summary: The Water and Infrastructure Committee deferred Bill 1, about subdivision water reviews, until the Board of Water Supply comments.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Kōmike Aloha ʻĀina
meetings.headline: Committee hears update on county HR overhaul project
meetings.summary: The committee heard an update on Align HR, a county project aiming for faster hiring, and deferred the item.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee reviews possible county purchase of Maui Land and Pineapple water assets
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed a non-binding MOU on buying Maui Land and Pineapple Company water assets and deferred the item.

meetings.body: Maui Police Commission Rejects Investigator Recommendation
meetings.headline: Maui Police Commission Rejects Investigator Recommendation
meetings.summary: The Maui Police Commission declined to accept a recommendation for its investigator position and deferred the matter to its next meeting.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.summary: The committee heard testimony on three bills for a proposed Haʻikū Fire Station and went into recess at 12:09.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers possible County purchase of Maui Land and Pine water assets
meetings.summary: The committee discussed the possible County purchase of Maui Land and Pine water systems in West Maui and Upcountry, and the chair deferred the item until the administration has reports a member requested. The Council must approve any final purchase.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee advances land-fund disclosure bill, hears tax update
meetings.summary: The committee voted nine ayes to recommend passing Bill 81 on first reading and heard new TAT software goes live in October.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers Bill 99 on nepotism, discusses Board of Ethics enforcement time limits
meetings.summary: The committee deferred Bill 99 and discussed Bill 55, which would let the Board of Ethics pursue violations for up to six years. The chair said the bills will return, with no date set yet.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.summary: The committee heard a plan for the County to buy two private West Maui water systems for up to $6 million.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee hears tiny-home village update and storm damage to parks
meetings.summary: The committee heard updates on a 64-home tiny-home village for homeless people and on storm damage to county parks, including the closed Kula gym.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.summary: The committee questioned staff on buying two water systems sold as one package; Council Member Sugimura's committee takes it up August 4th.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.summary: The committee discussed the County buying two water systems' assets as a package deal; no vote was taken.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses County purchase of two West Maui water systems for up to $6 million
meetings.summary: The committee discussed buying two private water systems priced at $3.5 million and $2.5 million; the chair said the item was for discussion only. It is expected at Council Member Sugimura's committee on August 4, and the County will not buy without PUC approval.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council advances hotel rezoning for some apartment-zoned properties
meetings.summary: The council adopted two hotel rezoning resolutions for apartment-zoned properties, each 7–1, and backed a first-look home resale bill proposal.

meetings.body: Board of Variances and Appeals
meetings.headline: Flood and building permit appeals continued to December 10
meetings.summary: The board continued two permit violation appeals to December 10th, 2026, while the appellants arrange an archaeological survey.

meetings.body: Committee on the Status Of Women
meetings.headline: Committee on the Status Of Women
meetings.summary: The committee heard from the county Director of Human Concerns and voted to combine its Women of Excellence event with its July 2027 women's conference.

meetings.body: Maui Commission on Children & Youth
meetings.headline: Youth commission advances press release and youth group plans
meetings.summary: The commission approved its June minutes, moved a press release forward, and planned a flyer for a youth advisory group.

meetings.body: East Maui Water Board
meetings.headline: East Maui Water Board
meetings.summary: East Maui board hears of a $6 million draft West Maui water deal, picks state-meeting testifiers, and sets an August 17th Kula meeting.

meetings.body: Fire Commission
meetings.headline: Fire Commission
meetings.summary: The commission heard testimony on firefighter pay and voted to add the issue to next month's agenda; MEMA reported a $9.58 million budget.

meetings.body: Maui Board of Water Supply
meetings.headline: Maui Board of Water Supply
meetings.summary: Without a quorum, the Board of Water Supply heard the desalination report should be released by the next meeting, with public hearings in early August.

meetings.body: Lānaʻi Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Planning commission hears zoning rewrite and shoreline rules briefings
meetings.summary: Commissioners heard briefings on the zoning code rewrite and shoreline rules; new SMA minor permit rules head to the mayor for signature.

meetings.body: Maui Has 45,737 Kūpuna Over 60
meetings.headline: Maui Has 45,737 Kūpuna Over 60
meetings.summary: The Council on Aging heard about Lānaʻi home health care, a needs survey for the four-year plan, and an older adult's contractor fraud case.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission - Meeting of July 14, 2026
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission - Meeting of July 14, 2026
meetings.summary: The commission approved restrooms and showers at Mākena State Park, six to one, with a carrying capacity study due by July 31, 2029.

meetings.body: Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The board met in closed session on an applicant's eligibility and heard the County Council passed, on first reading, an amendment to dissolve it.

meetings.body: Blind Advocate Challenges Maui County on Accessibility Gaps
meetings.headline: Blind Advocate Challenges Maui County on Accessibility Gaps
meetings.summary: The commission heard a talk on blindness and voted to explore a list of accessibility problems reported by the public.

meetings.body: Maui Arborist Committee
meetings.headline: Committee adds ʻulu tree and monkeypod grove to exceptional trees list
meetings.summary: The committee approved an ʻulu tree and 22 monkeypods as exceptional trees and heard testimony against a subdivision board's tree removal plan.

meetings.body: Maui Liquor Commission Debates Rule Changes to Help Struggling Restaurants
meetings.headline: Maui Liquor Commission Debates Rule Changes to Help Struggling Restaurants
meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Commission met on Wednesday, July 8.

meetings.body: Maui Board of Ethics
meetings.headline: Maui Board of Ethics
meetings.summary: The Maui Board of Ethics approved two advisory opinions finding no conflicts and formed a working group to review Charter section 10-4.4.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council approves energy contract financing, passes bills, refers water system purchase
meetings.summary: Members voted 9–0 to finance Phase 3 of an energy savings contract, and Bill 68 on West Maui parking passed first reading 9–0. Resolution 26-116 on water system assets went to the Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee.

meetings.body: Maalaea Shoreline Home & Olowalu Ag Estate Reviewed
meetings.headline: Maalaea Shoreline Home & Olowalu Ag Estate Reviewed
meetings.summary: The board backed roof and tree recommendations for a Māʻalaea home and recommended a community meeting on an Olowalu farm-home project.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee passes amended Resolution 26-110 on timeshare and leasehold properties
meetings.summary: The amended resolution passed six to two, with one member excused. The chair said it is only a recommendation: the Planning Commission has 120 days to review it, and it then comes back to the council for discussion.

meetings.body: Maui Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.summary: Commissioners approved the old county courthouse renovation plans by voice vote.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses Bill 95 bus fares; motion on bill passes with seven ayes
meetings.summary: Bill 95 would write new bus fares into County code, and the director discussed up to 14 fare-free days, each costing about $2,806 in uncollected fares. A motion on the bill passed with seven ayes and no noes.

meetings.body: Maui MPO TAC
meetings.headline: Maui MPO TAC
meetings.summary: Members approved the June 2, 2026 minutes by voice vote.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends Lahaina church rezoning bill as amended, 9-0
meetings.summary: The 9-0 vote covers Bill 94-2026, which would rezone Lahaina United Methodist Church land from R2 Residential to P1 Public/Quasi-Public, with acreage amended to 3.26. A land use zoning map and committee report are needed before first reading.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee weighs rezoning apartment properties for short-term rentals, recesses to July 6
meetings.summary: The committee closed oral testimony, with written testimony still accepted, and recessed until July 6, 2026 at 11 a.m. Affected properties would get letters if the resolutions pass, and the Planning Commission may hear the matter in mid or late September.

meetings.body: Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission met July 1, 2026, in person and online.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee reviews Spire Hawaiʻi fraud risk report, discusses direct pay at Water Supply
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed the fraud risk assessment, which found no nepotism policy and no countywide fraud complaint policy. The chair asked staff to send it to boards and commissions, and the committee next meets July 28, 2026 at 1:30 p.m.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Safe parking pilot site needs about five more months
meetings.summary: The committee heard the Safe Parking Pilot site needs about five months of work, and it deferred the item.

meetings.body: Lumeria Maui Appeal Continued to September
meetings.headline: Lumeria Maui appeal hearing delayed for more settlement talks
meetings.summary: The Board of Variance and Appeals delayed the Lumeria Maui appeal hearing so both sides can try one more settlement conference.

meetings.body: Molokaʻi Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Planning commission approves home exemption; chair raises water capacity questions
meetings.summary: The commission approved an SMA exemption for a single-family home after the chair questioned water and wastewater capacity in the subdivision.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends passage of energy contract financing, discusses grant rules
meetings.summary: The committee voted to recommend passage, as amended, of a resolution to finance a Johnson Controls Inc. energy contract by lease purchase. On the grants rules bill, staff will ask the administration when rulemaking is required.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission Defers Mākena State Park SMA Permit
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission Defers Mākena State Park SMA Permit
meetings.summary: The Maui Planning Commission adopted a written decision 5–2, denied a late petition to intervene, and deferred the Mākena State Park permit to July 14.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends council adopt resolution on lawsuit settlements and special counsel bills
meetings.summary: The committee voted 6–0 to recommend the full council adopt a resolution sending all settlement offers to the council and having Council Services attorneys review special counsel's bills. It moves to the full council; the next meeting covers an auditors' fraud risk report.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council considers Hoʻonani Village land bills, accessory dwelling units and noise fines
meetings.summary: Bills for the Hoʻonani Village project would change 163.443 acres in Kahului from agriculture to business and multi-family; Bill 163 needs a Maui public hearing before final reading. An amendment raising noise fines in Bill 119 passed seven ayes, two noes.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.summary: The Council adopted a Pride Month resolution with nine ayes and zero noes and heard a request to buy land for a new upcountry well.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council approves Kula well site purchase 9–0, hears testimony on Bill 88
meetings.summary: The purchase covers 1.714 acres in Kula from Haleakalā Ranch Company. The council also passed Bills 69, 83, 92 and 93 on final reading, 9–0, and heard Office of Hawaiian Affairs and condo owner testimony on Bill 88.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee files Resolution 25-215, discusses nomination board and claims filing
meetings.summary: Members voted 9–0 to file Resolution 25-215. They heard the mayor's office supported Resolution 26-93 to dissolve the Independent Nomination Board, and a deputy clerk said changing where claims are filed needs a charter amendment.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discharges claims resolution without recommendation, acts on two others
meetings.summary: Members voted 9-0 to send the claims resolution to the full council without a recommendation and 9-0 to recommend passing the computation of time resolution. Filing was recommended for transfer of appropriations. Most likely on the July 7th agenda.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee advances emergency funding charter change, revisits notice proposals
meetings.summary: The committee voted 8–0, with one member excused, to recommend Resolution 2688 on first reading. Members withdrew motions on deferred public meeting notice proposals after a deputy corporation counsel said a proposal conflicts with state law.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee sends claims proposal on without recommendation, defers vacancy item
meetings.summary: Members voted 9–0 to pass the claims proposal along with no recommendation, and the council vacancy proposal was deferred without objection. A committee report goes to the full council, most likely on July 7th.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses 2026 storm recovery, SBA loans and Kīhei gulch sediment; item deferred
meetings.summary: The committee took up DRIP 9.4 on long-term recovery from the 2026 storms, including SBA loans, 92 damaged County sites and about $100 million in damages. The item was deferred without objection.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Planning staff update council committee on zoning code rewrite
meetings.summary: Planning staff updated the committee on the Title 19 zoning code rewrite, begun in 2019, and the item was deferred.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee approves CD1 version of Resolution 2695, defers Resolution 2686
meetings.summary: Members also took up Resolution 2611 on filling a County Council vacancy. The committee plans to take up the remaining charter amendments and deferred proposals when it reconvenes.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses bill on housing funds for houseless residents, likely to defer
meetings.summary: The housing director said the department would work with a nonprofit partner, suggested softer wording than "ensure," and noted no fiscal year 27 funds are set aside. The chair said the bill will likely be deferred, and a safe parking program will be discussed June 29th.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses Bill 77 on Affordable Housing Fund and houseless residents, recesses
meetings.summary: The committee heard public testimony and questions on Bill 77, which would require part of the Affordable Housing Fund to go toward housing for houseless people. It recessed with a second round of member questions still to come; no vote was reported.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses Bill 77-2026 on Affordable Housing Fund use for houseless residents
meetings.summary: The housing director said the fund's current wording is broad enough and suggested softening the word ensure. The chair said the committee would probably defer the bill and invite the Director of Human Concerns. A safe parking program is planned for June 29th.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends Bill 68 parking changes on first reading in 9-0 vote
meetings.summary: The bill updates Park Maui rules, including two free hours for Hawaiʻi residents at the Wailuku Garage and paid parking zones at three Lahaina lots. It now goes to the full council.

meetings.body: Maui Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission sets open search for personnel director
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission voted to fill the personnel services director job through open recruitment and formed a working group to plan hiring.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council files Bill 102 Wailuku property funding, discusses Bill 88 hotel districts
meetings.summary: Members voted 9–0 to file Bill 102, which would fund buying a Wailuku property. They also discussed Bill 88, which would create H3 and H4 hotel districts for A1 and A2 apartment-district properties, and a budget amendment directing up to $3 million to Maui Economic Opportunity Inc.

meetings.body: Liquor Board Fines Southshore Tiki Lounge $4,000 for Minor Sale
meetings.headline: Liquor Board Fines Southshore Tiki Lounge $4,000 for Minor Sale
meetings.summary: The board fined Southshore Tiki Lounge $2,000 on each of two counts after it pleaded no contest to serving a minor decoy.

meetings.body: Maui County Council
meetings.headline: Council welcomes Fukuyama sister city delegation
meetings.summary: The Maui County Council welcomed a Fukuyama City delegation with speeches, music, hula, lei and gifts honoring the sister city relationship.

meetings.body: Maui Liquor Board Fines 3 Bars for Serving Minors
meetings.headline: Maui Liquor Board Fines 3 Bars for Serving Minors
meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Adjudication Board met Thursday, June 4.

meetings.body: Liquor Board Fines Pāʻia Fish Market $5,000 for Serving Minor
meetings.headline: Liquor board fines fish market restaurant for serving a minor
meetings.summary: The board fined a fish market restaurant $2,000 and $3,000 on two counts after a cashier served beer to a 19-year-old decoy.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses shoreline erosion impacts on coastal properties; chair proposes deferral
meetings.summary: The committee's only agenda item was shoreline erosion, with presentations and public testimony. The chair said the item would be deferred if there were no objections; no member response is recorded in the facts.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee approves amendments to accessory dwelling bill, discusses Molokaʻi B&B cap
meetings.summary: Members approved two amendments to the bill on accessory dwelling units, each with seven ayes. The county must adopt its rules by December 31, 2026. The committee also took up a bill capping Molokaʻi bed and breakfast homes at five.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee passes petition deadline change, defers notice, day-counting, claims items
meetings.summary: The committee also filed the proposal on posting bill digests online. It recessed until June 16, 2026, when the notice and day-counting proposals are to return as one combined proposal and discussion of the claims proposal continues.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers energy contract item, takes up Bill 181 homeowner exemption increase
meetings.summary: The chair postponed the Johnson Controls Inc. energy performance contract. On Bill 181 (2025), which would raise two property tax exemptions, the chair asked about deferring, and a motion to file and its second were withdrawn. No final action is stated.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.summary: YouthLine Hawaiʻi described its youth crisis line, presenters proposed a youth campus on golf course land, and both items were deferred.

meetings.body: Housing Advisory Board
meetings.headline: Housing board adjourns early over Sunshine Law concern
meetings.summary: Housing board adjourns early over Sunshine Law concern.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends passing bill creating H3 and H4 districts, 6–1
meetings.summary: The committee voted six to one, with two members excused, to recommend passage. An amendment leaving Molokaʻi out of the new districts passed earlier. The bill now goes to the full council.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meetings.headline: Committee approves revised bus ad bill, defers Climate Action and Resiliency Revolving Fund bill
meetings.summary: The committee voted 6–0 to replace Bill 13 (2026) with a CD1 version on County bus ads. Bill 66 (2026), proposing a climate fund starting at 20 percent of TAT revenue, was deferred; the chair said it will probably return in the next few meetings.

meetings.body: Maui Fire Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Fire Commission
meetings.summary: The Fire and Public Safety Commission re-elected its chair and heard salary and emergency management updates before audio problems ended the meeting.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee sends vehicle noise fine bill to full council
meetings.summary: The committee voted to send Bill 119-2025, which would raise fines for loud vehicle sound systems, to the full council.

meetings.body: Maui Police Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Police Commission
meetings.summary: The Maui Police Commission heard an undercover operation led to four arrests and voted to seek a 5% raise for the chief.

meetings.body: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission elected officers, found a hotel restaurant renovation exempt from a coastal-zone permit, and heard training on planning and open-meetings law.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee replaces Bill 164 with revised version, discusses Kahuluʻi land bills
meetings.summary: Bill 163 would put Kahuluʻi land inside the urban growth boundary, and Bill 164 would change its plan use to business multifamily. Bill 165 is held for the Land Use Commission; full council will learn if five or six votes are needed.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses three Kahuluʻi land bills, takes no action on Bill 165 zoning change
meetings.summary: Testifiers spoke in support and raised concerns about the airport flight path and water from an old agricultural well. The bills go to the full council, which will say whether five or six votes are needed to pass them.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee sends housing project to Planning Commission, recommends farm notice measure
meetings.summary: After testimony for and against, the committee recommended sending a housing and business project's plan and zoning changes to the Planning Commission. It also recommended adopting Resolution 26-68, on farm tenant notice before subdividing, on a 5–2 roll call vote.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends Bill 83 on first reading, 9-0, and discusses Hālau funds and grants
meetings.summary: The committee recommended Bill 83 on first reading with nine ayes, moving $372,933 from the Sewer Fund to the open space fund for Central Maui Wastewater Facility land. It also discussed Bill 69 on grants and Hālau funding.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers Martin settlement, passes Myers-Nave legal fee resolution
meetings.summary: The settlement in Charlotte Martin v. County of Maui (Resolution 26-81) was deferred. A motion to adopt Resolution 26-82, adding $240,000 for Myers-Nave's wildfire lawsuit work, passed with eight ayes and one excused, and it goes to the full council.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses Bill 76 water fee change and an overnight parking ban
meetings.summary: The committee discussed Bill 76, which would base the water system development fee on daily water use rather than meter size, and took testimony on a parking ban. The chair said the parking bill will return with Public Works, police and Human Concerns present.

meetings.body: 'Aha Wai o Maui Hikina East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meetings.headline: Board briefed on state hearing over ditch system ownership
meetings.summary: The board heard a briefing on a state land board meeting about the ditch system, adopted the director's evaluation, and went into closed session.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Notice of Public Hearing
meetings.headline: Council holds fuel tax rate hearing; no one indicated a desire to testify
meetings.summary: The Council opened testimony on Resolution 2663, which relates to adopting fuel tax rates for the County of Maui. The proposed rates would take effect July 1, 2026. Six members were present, three were excused, and the meeting adjourned.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Notice of Public Hearing
meetings.headline: Council adopts tax rates, approves housing grant bid, passes budget report
meetings.summary: Council members adopted new real property tax rates nine to zero and approved a $1,932,564 federal housing grant application due June 2, 2026. They passed the budget committee report nine to zero and added conditions to a temple grant, also nine to zero.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Notice of Public Hearing
meetings.headline: Council holds public hearing on fiscal year 2027 motor vehicle weight tax rates
meetings.summary: The council took public testimony on proposed motor vehicle weight tax rates for fiscal year 2027, with seven members present and two excused. The chair closed public testimony, accepted written testimony and adjourned the meeting.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council accepts $5,000 storm donation, sends park zoning change to Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The council voted 9–0 to accept a $5,000 donation for March 2026 storm recovery and sent a Maui Research and Technology Park District zoning change to the Maui Planning Commission. It also filed a bill tied to a stewardship group's funding.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee recommended passing fiscal year 27 budget bills and Bill 76 on water system fees on first reading.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee adjusts FY27 budget, passes property tax tier change 8-1, recesses to Monday
meetings.summary: The committee worked through the proposed fiscal year 27 budget, setting aside up to $9 million for Hoʻonani Village well and water work. It passed a non-owner-occupied property tax tier change 8-1 and will take up general budget provisions at 10 a.m. Monday.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee removed police radio project funding, raised the small-grant limit to $30,000, and lowered the emergency fund by $32 million.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee works on FY27 budget, adds funds for hospice, power supply and wildfire recovery
meetings.summary: The committee approved $150,000 for a medical-device power supply program, $750,000 for rural hospice care and up to $3 million for upcountry wildfire recovery, 8-1. Budget review was set to resume the next day at nine o'clock.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Public Meeting
meetings.headline: Residents testify on proposed Maui property tax rates
meetings.summary: The Maui County Council heard testimony on proposed property tax rates and tiers, including from bed-and-breakfast and vacation rental owners.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee cuts fire funds, passes Lahaina land trust grant and housing bonds
meetings.summary: Cuts included $94,556 for fire administration positions and $65,000 for a fire department vehicle. Members passed a $6 million grant and $4.5 million in bonds for homes for domestic violence victims, each with nine ayes, then recessed during a $3 million Affordable Housing Fund motion.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee reviews Bill 55, approves cuts and bus fare change, adjourns until tomorrow
meetings.summary: Members made budget changes under Bill 55, including a $140,000 Category A cut and $170,000 for bus hub security, and removed student ages from bus fare rules. The committee plans to meet tomorrow at 10.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee approves $40,000 for environmental grants and $500,000 sewer borrowing cut
meetings.summary: A motion adding $40,000 to environmental protection grants, with up to $40,000 for Haʻikū Community Association stream testing, carried. The sewer motion on bond borrowing for a wastewater pump station project passed with eight ayes, one member excused.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee heard testimony on Tutu and Me, housing and water rates, and approved a coral reef grant condition with eight ayes.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee approves housing changes, discusses Kīhei property purchase
meetings.summary: Members added $165,000 for a homeowner and housing counseling program, one unfunded housing specialist position, and earlier fee waivers to rates and fees, each with nine ayes. A member moved to lower the Cove Beach Village amount to $2.5 million.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee weighs cuts, housing bonds; wastewater cut fails 4–4
meetings.summary: Testifiers urged Tutu and Me preschool funding; a motion to delete a village wastewater project's funding failed 4–4; domestic violence housing bonds passed.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee sets ʻOhana Assistance Program minimum, cuts $140,000 for new positions
meetings.summary: Members voted with nine ayes to add missing license classes to the liquor fee list and to set at least $3 million for ʻOhana Assistance Program grants. A $35,000 Personnel Services cut failed. The meeting continues tomorrow at 10.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee cuts two grant items, keeps $2.5 million for village wastewater project
meetings.summary: The committee cut $100,000 from Green Building and Resilient Housing Grants and $50,000 from renewable energy grants. A motion to delete $2.5 million for a village association's wastewater project failed four to four; motions on Finance positions and software also failed.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee began making decisions on the proposed fiscal year 27 county budget.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council adopts Kahoʻolawe resolution, discusses Bills 74 and 75, refers Bill 68
meetings.summary: Bill 74 would let emergency funds pay county costs and aid for all recent severe weather events. Bill 75 would grant $6 million to Hawaiʻi Community Lending for the Lahaina Residential rebuild. Bill 68 went to the Water and Infrastructure Committee with no objections.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee hears public testimony on mayor's proposed budget from Lahaina fire survivors
meetings.summary: At a listening session on BFED 1, testifiers raised long-term recovery funding, rental help and a Lahaina land trust request, and one objected to a $60 million increase. The chair closed testimony and adjourned; a council member will report to the next meeting.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Public Hearing
meetings.headline: Residents seek funding at fiscal year 2027 budget hearing
meetings.summary: Residents asked the Maui County Council for budget money for a memorial, disaster recovery, farmers, and transitional housing at a fiscal year 2027 hearing.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed the Department of Environmental Management's budget, including a 9% sewer rate increase, and deferred the item.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The budget committee reviewed Environmental Management's proposed 13.5% budget increase, including a 9% average sewer rate increase, and closed public testimony.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget panel hears Environmental Management plan and sewer rate increase
meetings.summary: The budget committee heard the Environmental Management budget plan, including a 9% sewer rate increase, and closed public testimony.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Lānaʻi residents share budget priorities with Council committee
meetings.summary: Residents testified on the mayor's proposed budget, asking for farm support, a bigger college building, a community center and help for kūpuna.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee takes public testimony on fiscal year 27 budget at Kīhei meeting
meetings.summary: The committee met in Kīhei with the fiscal year 27 budget as its only item. Testifiers raised the Citizen Forester Program, farm water access, and Wailuku Water's $13 million offer. Mediation Services of Maui asked for $154,000 more.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: At a Kīhei budget hearing, residents raised Wailuku water rates, Cove Park wastewater, eviction mediation and disaster recovery funding.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed water and management budgets, including $176 million in water projects and $21 million for temporary housing, then deferred the item.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee takes up fiscal year 27 budget, hearing fire, housing and public testimony
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed the proposed fiscal year 27 County of Maui budget, with the fire chief reporting a 0.6% increase and the housing department asking for $4.4 million more for rental assistance. The chair closed public testimony and accepted written testimony.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee holds first community meeting and takes public testimony
meetings.summary: Speakers, limited to three minutes each, addressed bus service, STEM programs, transitional housing, deer damage to farmland and farm funding. The chair said the committee will receive a summary of the testimony.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers Aloha House care item and East Maui Water Authority budget review
meetings.summary: The committee deferred both items without objection: Aloha House's substance abuse care, and the East Maui Water Authority's operations and fiscal year 2026 budget. The authority's director said a capacity update is due in the next couple of weeks.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses Bill 176 road agreement and Bill 1 on water department plan review
meetings.summary: The committee took up Bill 176, a 10-year road maintenance agreement with the state, and Bill 1, on reviewing subdivision plans before water is verified. A request to send Bill 1 to the Board of Water Supply was made, and the committee will work with County lawyers on the policy plan question.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.summary: The council advanced limits on new West Maui pools, approved a Lānaʻi housing land lease, and sent a hotel-district plan to planning commissions.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Water committee defers Bill 108 on USGS water monitoring agreement
meetings.summary: The committee discussed Bill 108 (2025), a joint funding agreement with USGS for Oct. 1, 2025 to Sept. 30, 2026 that also funds a West Maui monitoring well site study. The chair deferred the item; the bill still needs second and final reading.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends Kahului workforce housing resolution, hears board applicant
meetings.summary: The resolution supports a future land transfer for about 100 workforce rental units at the Kahului Community Center park site, with details to return to the council later. The committee also heard an East Maui board applicant; a resolution is planned for the August 12 council agenda.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council approves hazard pay settlement and tax committee, passes farm tourism bill
meetings.summary: Members passed Bill 56, a water rate discount for native species habitat use, on first reading and sent an off-street parking bill for housing to the Lānaʻi, Maui, and Molokaʻi Planning Commissions. Bill 75 allows agricultural tourism on working farms.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee takes up Bill 9 phase-out dates, sends resort question to TIG
meetings.summary: Staff said the committee amended the phase-out dates to set a separate period for West Maui. The question of excluding resort properties will go to the TIG, and the administration said it would work with the council on a path for owners to seek rezoning.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee reviews emergency agency plan, hears public testimony
meetings.summary: The committee heard the emergency management agency's 2026 budget request and public testimony, and the chair deferred the item without decisions.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: In fiscal year 2026 budget talks, the fire chief said a $15 million Haʻikū Fire Station grant was lost, and planning cited uncompetitive salaries.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers Bill 111 on removing and storing personal property in public places
meetings.summary: The committee deferred Bill 111 (2024) with no objections after a special meeting held to meet a 90-day timeline. The chair said the vice chair will likely bring amendments after the budget.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee passes Bill 32 on first reading, defers grant overview and budget procedures
meetings.summary: Bill 32 passed first reading, eight ayes with one excused. The committee deferred the federal disaster recovery grant overview and budget procedures. The Mayor's budget is due March 25, and committee budget deliberations begin March 31.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.summary: The committee voted 6–2 to recommend an East Maui Regional Community Board appointment and deferred a safe parking pilot project update.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council approves Lahaina Community Land Trust items, rejects Planning Commission nominee
meetings.summary: The council approved grant exceptions 8-0 and a managed retreat fund resolution 9-0 for the trust, and rejected a Maui Planning Commission nominee 5-4. Bill 26 on fire code fines went to committee for questions to the fire department.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meetings.headline: Committee reviews farm, water, environment, ferry and bus programs
meetings.summary: Committee reviews farm, water, environment, ferry and bus programs.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.summary: The committee voted eight to zero to recommend buying land in Lahaina and deferred Bills 103 and 104.

meetings.body: Maui County Salary Commission Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Salary Commission Meeting
meetings.summary: The Salary Commission heard a draft County of Maui salary study from MGT Consulting and voted to move its March meeting to March 28.

meetings.body: Hana Advisory Committee to the Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Hāna committee backs land change for clinic housing and specialty clinic
meetings.summary: The committee voted five in favor to recommend approval of a land change for Hāna Health workforce housing and a specialty clinic.

meetings.body: Maui County Commission on Children & Youth
meetings.headline: Maui County Commission on Children & Youth
meetings.summary: The commission chose five posters for buses and voted to have the vice chair write a letter of support to the Budget and Finance committee.

meetings.body: E. Maui Regional Board (Water Authority)
meetings.headline: E. Maui Regional Board (Water Authority)
meetings.summary: The East Maui Regional Board named its chair and vice chair to any East Maui irrigation system negotiations and adopted a motto.

meetings.body: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission approved an SMA exemption for Molokaʻi Community Health Center's renovations and heard an update on the Molokaʻi landfill.

meetings.body: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Commission approved two restaurant liquor licenses, including Star Noodle's post-wildfire move, and deferred the director's evaluation to January.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Ethics
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Ethics
meetings.summary: The Board of Ethics voted on two requests for ethics advice and met in a closed-door session.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission - South Maui Plan
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission - South Maui Plan
meetings.summary: Reviewing the South Maui Community Plan, the Maui Planning Commission voted down two map motions for the Maui Research and Technology Park.

meetings.body: Maui County Council On Aging
meetings.headline: Maui County Council On Aging
meetings.summary: The Council on Aging approved its August 13 minutes, but a motion to approve its plan report stalled without a quorum.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission voted to recommend amending, not deleting, a water condition on a West Maui housing project.

meetings.body: Maui County Animal Control Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Animal Control Board
meetings.summary: The Animal Control Board voted unanimously to remove past contested case minutes and hearing records from its County web page.

meetings.body: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.summary: The commission put off a decision on Imua Family Services' preschool plan and approved plans for two homes rebuilt after the 2023 fire.

meetings.body: Maui County Liquor Adjudication Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Liquor Adjudication Board
meetings.summary: The liquor board fined two restaurants: $1,000 with $750 suspended, and $2,000 on each of two counts.

meetings.body: Maui County Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Commission approves minutes, hears evaluation, union and budget updates
meetings.summary: The commission approved its November 6, 2024 minutes and heard updates on the director's review, union contract talks and the budget.

meetings.body: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The Independent Nomination Board reviewed 2025 nomination applicants in closed session and chose people to interview, including for the Housing Advisory Board.

meetings.body: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The Independent Nomination Board met in closed session on 2025 applications, then sent applicants forward for several boards and recessed until December 4th.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission sought a closed Lahaina site visit, approved a beach park graywater permit, and deferred a resort case to January 28.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Council passes Kīhei light industrial rezoning on first reading with housing condition
meetings.summary: Rezoning of 14.626 acres on Ohukai Road passed first reading, eight ayes with one excused, after a condition requiring outreach and a council resolution before multifamily housing passed 7-1. A ban on condominium property regimes failed, 4-5.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The Maui Planning Commission met to keep working on the South Maui Community Plan.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting
meetings.summary: The Maui County Board of Ethics formed a group to review its gift guide and approved a press release on confidentiality.

meetings.body: MPO Policy Board
meetings.headline: MPO Policy Board
meetings.summary: The board approved a full 2045 transportation plan update with work extended to mid-April and agreed with state road classification reports.

meetings.body: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The Lānaʻi Planning Commission voted to start a parking code change and heard legal limits on proposed commissioner talk-story sessions.

meetings.body: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.summary: Fire officials reported over $890,000 in first FEMA checks, and the commission voted to support the fire department's budget in a letter to the mayor.

meetings.body: Maui County Commission on Healing Solutions for Homelessness

meetings.summary: The board approved its 2025 meeting schedule.

meetings.headline: Maui County Cost of Government Commission
meetings.summary: The commission approved draft minutes, backed a 15% budget increase request, and deferred a West Maui Greenway study group so its scope can be refined.

meetings.summary: The commission was called to order at 11:10 a.m.

meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission set April 2025 as a tentative date to meet in person and learned two empty seats will stay open.

meetings.summary: The Public Works Commission conditionally approved street names, chose its 2025 chair and vice chair, and kept Wednesday 1:30 p.m. meetings.

meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed proposed changes to Bill 111 on removing and storing property in public places, then deferred it with no objections.

meetings.summary: The Police Commission voted to send letters to the mayor about an investigator job and to the salary commission about the chief's pay.

meetings.summary: The commission denied an exemption for demolishing a two-story home after questions about landfill disposal and the site went unanswered.

meetings.summary: The Maui Planning Commission heard testimony on the South Maui Community Plan, including the Promenade property, and took no action.

meetings.summary: The commission heard about new evacuation software, approved its minutes, heard housing safety concerns, and learned how the fire budget works.

meetings.summary: The committee voted to send a midwifery legislation letter to legislators toward the end of November and moved its budget vote to the next meeting.

meetings.headline: Committee recommends adoption of amended Resolution 24-161 on recycled R1 water
meetings.summary: The committee passed two changes to the resolution, each eight to zero, including one asking the administration to invest in R1 production at the Kahului, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi plants. The recommendation had seven ayes, one member excused; the chair said it will move on.

meetings.headline: Arborist Committee plans December tree-measuring visit
meetings.summary: The Arborist Committee approved August minutes, planned a December tree-measuring visit, and set its next meeting for November 13, 2024.

meetings.summary: The Board of Ethics moved complaint 247 to a formal hearing and voted to send out its current gift guide and campaign restrictions.

meetings.summary: The department said no rule or law limits a class 5 dispenser license to one category.

meetings.summary: The committee discussed West Maui Community Plan updates after the 2023 wildfires, heard how water limits housing, and deferred the draft resolution.

meetings.summary: The council approved a committee's recommended global settlement of County wildfire lawsuits from August 2023, with twice-yearly lawyer reports on future cases. It sent Bills 103 and 104 to Housing and Land Use and Bill 106 to Water and Infrastructure.

meetings.headline: Committee recommends agriculture grants bill, discusses Kīhei teacher housing purchase
meetings.summary: Seven members voted aye on the agriculture grants bill. The committee also heard retirement system and health fund updates, and the council is set to consider the Kīhei housing agreement this Friday.
